archetype: Performance Pro (Archetype 2) infused with Web3/Gaming neon accents

hierarchy.timer: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tighter text-cyan-400

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Control Room Grid - High density but perfectly organized for scanning active timers and revenue. Deep immersive gaming lounge vibe.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Use logical properties like ps-4, pe-4, ms-2, me-2 for RTL support.
layout_and_spacing.grid_rooms: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

room_card.idle: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all duration-300
room_card.active: bg-zinc-900 border border-cyan-500/50 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)] relative overflow-hidden
room_card.timer_display: font-mono text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold text-cyan-400 mt-2 mb-1 text-left
room_card.action_button: mt-4 w-full h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm transition-all

cafeteria_pos.container: bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-s border-zinc-800 p-6 flex flex-col h-full
cafeteria_pos.product_card: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-600 rounded-xl p-3 cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center text-center transition-colors
cafeteria_pos.cart_item: flex items-center justify-between p-3 border-b border-zinc-800/50 last:border-0

header.container: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/5 h-20 flex items-center justify-between px-6

stats_widget.container: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-6 flex items-center gap-4
stats_widget.label: text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow. Buttons brighten on hover.
motion_and_interactions.active_pulse: Active room cards should have a very subtle pulse animation on their border or a tracing beam effect to indicate live time.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-all duration-300 ease-out for standard interactions.

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Set dir='rtl' on the root HTML tag or main layout container. The entire UI must be Arabic Right-to-Left natively.
Use Tailwind logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, start-, end-) instead of directional ones (pl-, pr-, ml-, mr-) to ensure perfect RTL rendering.
Dashboard must show Live Sessions count, today's PlayStation revenue, and today's Cafeteria revenue as separate prominent stats widgets.
Rooms Grid must contain exactly 16 room cards.
Room card state MUST clearly differentiate 'Idle' (Slate/Gray border, muted text) and 'Active' (Neon Cyan border, glowing shadow, live elapsed monospace timer).
Session cost must be dynamically calculated based on elapsed minutes and the room's specific price per hour.

Cafeteria POS should be a persistent side panel on desktop or accessible via a bottom sheet/modal on mobile views. It must support adding items to a specific active room's bill or as a standalone purchase.
All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-session-btn', data-testid='room-card-1', data-testid='pos-add-item').
Avoid standard generic fonts. Use 'Tajawal' or 'Cairo' from Google Fonts for Arabic text to maintain a modern aesthetic. Apply via global css import.

Monospace font is MANDATORY for the session timers (e.g. 02:45:10) so the numbers do not jump around as seconds tick. Force LTR direction on the timer text itself if necessary to prevent layout flipping within the timer string.
Use Shadcn UI primitives customized to match the dark neon theme. No standard HTML select/inputs for complex interactions.
Add a subtle 'tracing beam' or animated border effect on active room cards to make the command-center feel alive.
